# Add ThemeSwitcher to Form, Component, Charts and StateProvider examples

## Context

Rollout leaf 3 of #21704 (Engine 14 release blocker, `@tobiu` `2026-11-21`): covers all remaining published non-`ConfigurationViewport` standalone examples across **Forms, Components & Wrappers, Charts, StateProvider, and Platform/Workers**.

## The Problem

In `apps/portal/resources/data/examples.json` (plus in-flight `#21515` `examples/form/checkout`), published standalone examples in these groups have no UI theme switcher, and several legacy `neo-config.json` files still list only a single theme (`["neo-theme-dark"]` or `["neo-theme-light"]`) even though Neo ships both light and dark themes:
- **Forms:** `examples/form/validation` (`2` themes), plus `examples/form/checkout` (`#21339` / `#21515` once merged)
- **Components, Canvas & Wrappers:** `examples/component/sparkline` (`2`), `examples/component/wrapper/mermaid` (`2`), `examples/component/wrapper/openStreetMaps` (`2`), `examples/component/markdown`, `examples/component/toast`, `examples/component/graphScene`, `examples/charts`, `examples/component/{gallery,helix,coronaGallery,coronaHelix,multiWindowHelix,multiWindowCoronaGallery}`, `examples/videoMove`
- **State, Data & Platform (published non-workbench entries):** `examples/stateProvider/{advanced,multiWindow,...}` (check `apps/portal/resources/data/examples.json` for every published non-workbench entry in `State & Data`, `Multi-Window`, `Workers & Platform`, and `Functional Components`, upgrading single-theme `neo-config.json` files to `["neo-theme-neo-dark", "neo-theme-neo-light"]` or `["neo-theme-dark", "neo-theme-light"]` where supported!).

## The Architectural Reality

- Prerequisite #21705 provides `Neo.button.ThemeSwitcher` (`ntype: 'theme-switcher'`).
- Note that some entries under `examples/component/*` or `examples/charts` may extend `ConfigurationViewport` indirectly — verify each candidate's inheritance chain first and touch **only** non-`ConfigurationViewport` apps.
- For canvas/3D/gallery demos whose custom CSS hardcodes dark-only obsidian backgrounds (e.g. `helix` / `coronaGallery`), verify whether switching to light theme renders legibly before adding a second theme to `neo-config.json`; if a 3D space canvas is intentionally dark-stage-only or themes its chrome cleanly, ensure zero unreadable white-on-white labels!
- Design authority: #21704 binding inventory (`@tobiu` Engine 14 release gate).

## The Fix

1. Enumerate every published non-`ConfigurationViewport` standalone example in `apps/portal/resources/data/examples.json` outside the slices of #21706 and #21707 (plus `examples/form/validation` and any newly merged `form/*` demonstration).
2. Ensure each target example declares `>= 2` coherent themes in `neo-config.json`, honors `?theme=` on boot in `app.mjs`, and mounts `Neo.button.ThemeSwitcher` in its header/toolbar chrome.
3. Verify `1440 × 900` and `390 × 844` layout fit, legibility in every configured theme, and zero console/404 errors across touched examples.

Decision Record impact: none.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Every published non-`ConfigurationViewport` example in `apps/portal/resources/data/examples.json` across `Forms & Fields`, `Charts, Canvas & Maps`, `Buttons, Menus & Toolbars`, `Lists & Galleries`, `Dialogs & Overlays`, `More components`, `State & Data`, `Multi-Window`, `Workers & Platform`, and `Functional Components` (outside #21706 and #21707) exposes a working interactive theme switcher (`ThemeSwitcher` from #21705, or existing verified switcher in `calendar/basic`, `code/livePreview`, `component/video`, `dialog`).
- [ ] Every touched example renders legibly in all of its configured themes at `1440 × 900` and `390 × 844` with zero console/404 errors.
- [ ] Existing E2E specs for touched examples (`ValidationExample.spec.mjs`, sparkline/mermaid/portal specs, etc.) pass, plus an E2E check verifying live theme switching on representative examples in this slice.

## Out of Scope

- `board/*`, `scheduler/*`, `gantt/*`, `timeline/*` (#21706).
- `grid/*`, `table*`, `dashboard/*`, `desktop/*`, `menu/*`, `tab*`, `toolbar/*`, `list/*`, `layout/*` (#21707).
- `ConfigurationViewport` workbench examples.

## Avoided Traps

- Blindly adding `neo-theme-neo-light` to a dark-only WebGL/helix example without checking whether custom `.css` hardcodes white `#fff` text over a transparent background — verify computed contrast in both themes!
